The reason a verb call's dot goes to the CPU (F88)

Source: R/fallback.R
fallback_failed_reason.Rd

Reads what the call's own decision recorded (see the collector notes in R/fallback.R): the reason claimed for the failing dot, with that dot's text as the "expr" attribute (which gpu_fallback() takes as the notice's expr). Call it only right after the judge of the dots said one fails.

Usage

fallback_failed_reason(dots, default)

Arguments

dots

The dots the claim's index refers to (the user's)

default

The verb's own reason, used when the call claimed no dot or the claim names no cause (then without, or with, an expr)

Value

A reason string, with an "expr" attribute when a dot is known
